Resource – Assignment Details: 25DV06 – QCHEM Audit

Number of Resources required 4 Category 1- General Auditor 2 -Technical Auditor 3 - IT Auditor Category 1- General Auditor (1 Auditor) Category 2- Technical Auditor (3 Auditors) Dates Required Fieldwork phase: 04 – 29 May 2025 No. of Working Days 80 Man days (20 Days for each resource) Location Doha, Mesaieed and Ras Laffan HSE – type of HSE Office based and Site Safety. Data Confidentiality – list any specific requirements Contractor shall not discuss or share any information related to the assignment and obtained during the Audit with any other person outside of the Company Audit Team. Scope of Services: To participate as an Auditor in the Company Internal Audit . The objective of the audit is to provide independent assurance to the shareholders on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and control processes, including the following Audit areas: Governance Risk Management Corporate Strategic Planning and Performance Management Finance Human Resources Procurement and Contracts Supply Chain and Materials Management Inventory and Warehouse Production and
Operations Process Safety Maintenance

Asset Integrity Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Engineering Management IT / OT Measurement and Metering Laboratory Operations Investments and Project Management Services required: Perform audit work in accordance with Company internal auditing standards and IIA Standards. Review, understand and execute the audit program to meet the audit objectives. Document the audit testing results in a timely manner, with high quality and adequate working papers (using templates provided). Audit findings/observations to be well documented in Audit Memos with adequate supporting documentation. Discuss and agree the potential observations / gaps identified with the Lead Auditor on a timely basis. Discuss and agree with the auditee/client the agreed observations / gaps Document Audit Memos (within 2 days from their identification and agreement) and have them approved by the Lead Auditor. Audit Areas to be covered The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: General Auditor: Governance Risk Management Corporate Strategic Planning and Performance Management Finance Human Resources Procurement and Contracts Technical Auditor: Supply Chain and
Materials Management Inventory and Warehouse Production and Operations Process Safety
Maintenance Asset Integrity Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Engineering Management Measurement and Metering Laboratory Operations Investments and Project Management
